toolsPreview.name: calculate_churn_rate
toolsPreview.description: Calculate net revenue retention (NRR), gross revenue retention (GRR), revenue churn and implied customer lifetime from one period's MRR movements. Also reports the NRR-minus-GRR spread, which reveals how much churn is being masked by expansion revenue.

toolsPreview.name: analyze_revenue_concentration
toolsPreview.description: Assess customer concentration risk across a book of revenue using the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI), top-N share and whale detection. Answers the question every acquirer asks first: how much revenue walks out with one logo?

toolsPreview.name: detect_zombie_mrr
toolsPreview.description: Identify dormant-but-paying accounts — revenue that still counts in MRR but whose customers have stopped showing up. Zombie revenue is one renewal notice from cancelling and is invisible to standard revenue dashboards.

toolsPreview.name: score_saas_health
toolsPreview.description: Score a SaaS business 0-100 across five dimensions — retention, growth, concentration, efficiency and durability — and return the composite. Every mapping is published, so the score can be reconstructed by hand.

toolsPreview.name: calculate_ltv
toolsPreview.description: Calculate gross-margin-adjusted customer lifetime value, the LTV:CAC ratio and CAC payback in months. Omitting gross margin yields lifetime revenue rather than lifetime value — usually a third of the number.

toolsPreview.name: get_scoring_bands
toolsPreview.description: Return the scoring thresholds ChurnLens applies to NRR, revenue concentration and the composite health score. These are bands, not measured benchmark data — the sourced benchmark figures are cited at https://churnlens.site/benchmarks.
